description: Manage play-facing context controls: recap, verbosity, briefing_order, and tool discovery, distinct from story content and Novel lifecycle. recap accepts an archived session_id, GM-only gm_notes, and an optional compression tier; gm_notes are never returned to a non-GM badge. discover searches names, descriptions, and titles, and detail schema requires query. verbosity is session-scoped; briefing_order persists to the Novel and requires the GM or Editor badge. recap and discover are read-only; a setting is restored by setting it again (no undo snapshot is taken). Use when: recapping play, tuning output verbosity, reordering the briefing, or finding a tool. Do NOT use when: health, audit compaction, event-log, or category operations — use manage_diagnostics; recording story content — use manage_story (action: record).

budget_tokens.description: Positive token budget for tier assembly (recap; REQ-592) or for ledger packing (context_report; REQ-610).

detail.description: discover response detail: summary (default) or schema (live input schemas for the matches; requires query; REQ-609).

format.description: Recap/compress output notation (recap, compress; default markdown; REQ-072g).

gm_notes.description: GM-only free-text notes returned only to the Game Master badge (recap).

max_rolls.description: Significant rolls to return, bounded 1–50 (recap; default 5; REQ-072e).

max_transitions.description: Scene transitions to return, bounded 1–20 (recap; default 5; REQ-072e).

query.description: Optional search term matched against tool name, description, and title (discover).

session_id.description: Archived session id to include in recap (recap).

name: manage_context

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Context Controls
